title: 英文仿真卷 B（全科第3場）
subject: 英文

questions.stem: The parcel was returned because the _____ address had been written incorrectly.
questions.explain: destination 為「目的地」，destination address 即收件地址。definition 定義、declaration 申報單（customs declaration）、description 描述，三者與 de- 字首形近但語意無關。8/13 回收題此字誤選 definition，本題改以「退件原因」情境重出。

questions.stem: Customers who use registered mail are _____ to compensation if the item is lost.
questions.explain: be entitled to N/V 表「有權享有」，為固定搭配。entertain 娛樂、enter 進入、entrust 委託（entrust sb. with sth.）。四字同以 ent- 起首，屬形近字組。8/13 此字誤選 entertained，本題保留搭配結構、改換主詞與條件子句重測。

questions.stem: All customer data must be kept _____ and may not be shared with third parties.
questions.explain: confidential 機密的，修飾資料、文件；confident 是「有信心的」，修飾人。兩字僅差一個字尾卻分屬不同語意場，為本題核心。considerate 體貼的、convenient 方便的。8/13 此字誤選 confident，本題以 keep + O + adj. 結構重出。

questions.stem: The new tracking system has greatly _____ the efficiency of parcel delivery.
questions.explain: enhance 提升（品質、效率、價值）；enforce 是「執行、強制實施」，受詞多為 law、rule。endure 忍受、enclose 隨函附上。8/13 此字誤選 enforces，錯因即在 enhance/enforce 形近而語意相反方向，本題改以 efficiency 為受詞，使搭配線索更明確。

questions.stem: The clerk _____ the customer that the compensation would be paid within a week.
questions.explain: assure sb. that... 為「向某人保證」，受詞須為人；ensure 是「確保（某事發生）」，受詞為事，不接人＋that；insure 投保；assume 假定。8/13 此字誤選 ensured，判斷動作是「看空格後面接的是人還是事」——本題後接 the customer（人），故選 assure。

questions.stem: All parcels received before noon will be _____ on the same day.
questions.explain: dispatch 發送、派遣（郵件、貨物）。display 展示、dispose (of) 處理丟棄、dismiss 解僱或駁回。四字同以 dis- 起首，需以受詞判斷：parcels 只能被 dispatched。

questions.stem: The post office agreed to _____ the sender for the damaged goods.
questions.explain: compensate sb. for sth. 為「就某事賠償某人」，介系詞 for 為固定搭配。compete 競爭（compete with/for）、complete 完成、compare 比較（compare with/to）。名詞形 compensation 於郵政法規英文語境中高頻出現。

questions.stem: Only staff members who are _____ may open undeliverable mail.
questions.explain: authorize 授權，be authorized to V 表「經授權得以」。author 為「著作」（動詞少用）、automate 自動化、authentic 真正的（形容詞，不與 who are 後之被動語意相符）。本題以「僅經授權者得開拆」呼應郵政法第10條之情境。

questions.stem: Please _____ the recipient's identity before handing over the registered letter.
questions.explain: verify 查證、核實（身分、資訊）。vary 變化、value 重視或估價、violate 違反。掛號郵件投遞前須確認收件人身分，語境與 identity 搭配者只有 verify；名詞為 verification。

questions.stem: The claim must be filed before the six-month period _____.
questions.explain: expire 到期、屆滿，主詞多為 period、contract、passport。explore 探索、expand 擴大、expose 暴露。本題語境即補償請求權之六個月期間屆滿，與 file a claim（提出請求）搭配。

questions.stem: An _____ postal code helps the sorting machine process letters faster.
questions.explain: accurate 準確的，修飾資訊、數字、地址。accustomed 習慣的（be accustomed to）、acceptable 可接受的、accessible 可取得的。郵遞區號的關鍵屬性是「正確與否」而非「可否接受」，故 acceptable 為主要誘答。

questions.stem: The recipient must sign the return receipt to _____ delivery of the parcel.
questions.explain: acknowledge 承認、確認收訖，正是回執（return receipt）之功能。accomplish 完成、accompany 陪伴、accumulate 累積。四字同以 acc- 起首，判斷線索在 sign the receipt 這個動作的目的是「確認收到」。

questions.stem: When the original box was damaged, the clerk used a _____ container.
questions.explain: substitute 作形容詞時為「替代的」，亦可作名詞或動詞（substitute A for C）。subsequent 隨後的、substantial 大量的、sufficient 足夠的。原箱受損後所使用者為「替代」容器，時間先後（subsequent）並非重點，此為誘答設計。

questions.stem: The letter was returned to the sender because of _____ postage.
questions.explain: insufficient postage 郵資不足，即欠資郵件之英文表達。inevitable 不可避免的、invisible 看不見的、informal 非正式的。字首 in- 在此表否定，sufficient（足夠）加 in- 即為不足，與 sim-C 曾出之 sufficient 為同一字根之反向測驗。

questions.stem: The company is trying to _____ a new contract with the airline for mail transport.
questions.explain: negotiate 協商、談判，受詞常為 contract、terms、price。navigate 導航、nominate 提名、neglect 忽略。與 with the airline 搭配者只有 negotiate；名詞 negotiation 亦為常考字。

questions.stem: Registered mail _____ to be delivered within three working days.
questions.explain: be supposed to V 表「應該、按規定要」，形式為被動，主詞為受該規定拘束者。has supposed、supposes 為主動，語意變成「郵件認為」，不合理；is supposing 更無此用法。8/13 此點誤選 has supposed，判斷動作：看到 supposed to 就先確認前面是不是 be 動詞。

questions.point: 文法：had better 之否定（回收）
questions.stem: You _____ send cash by ordinary mail; it is neither traceable nor insured.
questions.explain: had better 之否定形式為 had better not + 原形動詞，not 置於 better 之後、原形動詞之前。had not better 為誤置，would better 不成結構，had better no 之 no 不能修飾動詞。此點 8/7、8/13 兩度失分，本次改測否定形以確認是否真的掌握結構而非語感。

questions.point: 文法：與現在事實相反之假設語氣
questions.stem: If the sender _____ the correct postal code, the parcel would arrive tomorrow.
questions.explain: 主要子句用 would + 原形，可知為「與現在事實相反」之假設，if 子句須用過去式 knew。had known 為與過去事實相反（主要子句應作 would have arrived），knows 為單純條件句（主要子句應為 will arrive），would know 不能置於 if 子句。判斷動作：先看主要子句的助動詞，再回頭決定 if 子句時態。

questions.point: 文法：關係代名詞 which 修飾物
questions.stem: The box _____ contains fragile items should be marked clearly.
questions.explain: 先行詞 the box 為物且關係子句中缺主詞，故用 which（亦可用 that）。who 用於人；whose 為所有格，其後應接名詞；what 不能作關係代名詞使用（本身已含先行詞）。判斷動作：先問「先行詞是人還是物」，再問「子句裡缺的是主詞、受詞還是所有格」。

questions.stem: _____ in a sturdy box, the glassware arrived without any damage.
questions.explain: 主詞 the glassware 與 pack 之間為被動關係（玻璃器皿被包裝），故用過去分詞 Packed 引導分詞構句。Packing 為主動，語意變成玻璃器皿自己包裝；To pack 表目的，與後半句不合；Pack 為原形動詞，不能引導分詞構句。判斷動作：把主詞抓出來，問它是「做」還是「被做」。

questions.stem: Express mail is _____ faster than ordinary mail, but it costs much more.
questions.explain: 修飾比較級（faster）須用 far、much、even、still、a lot 等；very 只能修飾原級（very fast）。so 與 too 亦僅修飾原級，且 too...to 另有結構。判斷動作：看到形容詞字尾 -er 或 more，修飾語就不能用 very。

questions.point: 文法：動名詞作主詞之單複數
questions.stem: Filling out the customs form correctly _____ delays at the border.
questions.explain: 動名詞片語作主詞時視為單數，故動詞用第三人稱單數 prevents。prevent 為複數動詞形，are preventing 與 have prevented 皆以複數處理主詞。判斷動作：主詞為 V-ing 開頭的片語時，一律當作單數，不受片語內名詞（form）的單複數影響。

questions.point: 文法：時間介系詞 by 與 until
questions.stem: The package must be picked up _____ Friday; otherwise it will be returned.
questions.explain: by + 時間點表「最遲在……之前完成」，用於一次性動作（pick up）。until 表「持續到某時」，須搭配持續性動作或狀態（如 wait until Friday）。since 用於完成式起點，during 後接期間名詞。判斷動作：問這個動作是「一次完成」還是「持續進行」。

questions.stem: The clerk explained _____ the compensation is calculated.
questions.explain: 名詞子句須用直述語序（主詞＋動詞），故 how the compensation is calculated 正確；how is 為疑問語序，不可用於子句。what 之後子句成分完整，無空缺可填，故不適用；that how 為兩個引導詞連用，結構重複。判斷動作：子句一律不倒裝。

questions.stem: The clerk sorted the letters with the machine _____ in the background.
questions.explain: with + 受詞 + 分詞為附帶狀況構句；the machine 與 run 為主動關係（機器在運轉），故用現在分詞 running。若為被動關係則用過去分詞（如 with the door closed）。to run 表目的、runs 為限定動詞，皆不能用於此結構。

questions.point: 文法：every 之單複數一致
questions.stem: Every parcel and letter _____ scanned before leaving the sorting center.
questions.explain: every 修飾之名詞即使以 and 連接，仍視為單數，故動詞用 is。此與 both...and 連接兩個名詞須用複數動詞不同。are、were、have been 皆為複數形。判斷動作：看到 every、each 起首的主詞，一律配單數動詞。

questions.point: 文法：現在完成式與 for
questions.stem: The company _____ this delivery service for over twenty years.
questions.explain: for + 一段時間表示從過去持續至今，須用現在完成式 has provided。過去簡單式 provided 表過去已結束之動作，與「持續至今」矛盾；現在進行式與現在簡單式均無法表達自過去累積之期間。判斷動作：看到 for/since + 期間，先想完成式。

questions.stem: The sender kept the receipt _____ prove that the parcel had been mailed.
questions.explain: 空格後為原形動詞 prove，故須用 in order to（或 so as to、to）表目的。so that 之後須接完整子句（主詞＋動詞），for 與 because of 之後須接名詞或動名詞。判斷動作：先看空格後面是「原形動詞」「完整子句」還是「名詞」，再選連接方式。

questions.point: 文法：被動語態之完成式
questions.stem: By the time the customer arrived, the parcel _____ already been returned.
questions.explain: By the time + 過去式子句，主要子句須用過去完成式；空格後為 already been returned，故補 had 構成 had been returned（過去完成被動）。has 為現在完成，與過去時間點不符；was been 不成結構；would been 亦誤。判斷動作：兩個過去動作比先後，先發生者用過去完成式。

questions.stem: _____ the item is properly packed, the post office may refuse to accept it.
questions.explain: Unless 等於 if...not，語意為「除非妥善包裝，否則郵局得拒收」，與後半句之否定結果相符。If 會使語意變成「若妥善包裝就拒收」，明顯矛盾；Although 為讓步；Whether 表二選一，不能引導條件。判斷動作：先把 unless 換成 if not 讀一遍，看語意是否成立。

questions.point: 克漏字一：複合關係副詞 whenever
questions.stem:
【克漏字（一）】請依下文回答第 31～35 題。

Smart parcel lockers have changed the way people collect their mail. Instead of waiting at home for the postman, customers can now pick up a package __31__ it is convenient for them. When a parcel is placed in a locker, the system sends a text message __32__ contains a code for opening the door. The service is popular in cities, where many residents are out at work during the day and __33__ to receive registered mail in person. There are limits, however. Items that are too large, too fragile, or too valuable __34__ be placed in a locker. Customers should also collect their parcels quickly; if a package stays in the locker for more than two days, it __35__ to a nearby post office for collection.

第 31 格：
questions.explain: 空格後為完整子句 it is convenient for them，且語意為「在任何方便的時候」，故用 whenever。however 表轉折或「無論如何」，whatever 指事物，wherever 指地點——本句已有 pick up a package 之地點意涵由 locker 承擔，時間才是語意重心。

questions.explain: 先行詞為 a text message（物），關係子句中缺主詞，故用 which。who 用於人；whose 為所有格須接名詞；where 為關係副詞，其後子句成分應完整，但此處 contains 缺主詞。

questions.point: 克漏字一：對等連接之動詞形式
questions.stem:
【克漏字（一）】請依下文回答第 31～35 題。

第 33 格：
questions.explain: and 連接的前後成分須對等：前為 are out at work，後亦須為「be 動詞＋補語」，故用 are unable（to receive）。unable 單獨出現缺少動詞；being unable 為分詞，不能與限定動詞對等連接；are not able to 語意雖同，但空格後已有 to receive，會造成 to 重複。

questions.point: 克漏字一：情態助動詞 cannot 表規定
questions.stem:
【克漏字（一）】請依下文回答第 31～35 題。

第 34 格：
questions.explain: 本句在列舉不得投入智慧郵箱之物品，語意為禁止，故用 cannot。must 表必須，語意相反；need not 表不必要，非禁止；would rather 表偏好，與規定語境不合。

questions.point: 克漏字一：被動語態之時態
questions.stem:
【克漏字（一）】請依下文回答第 31～35 題。

Smart parcel lockers have changed the way people collect their mail. Instead of waiting at home for the postman, customers can now pick up a package __31__ it is convenient for them. When a parcel is placed in a locker, the system sends a text message __32__ contains a code for opening the door. The service is popular in cities, where many residents are out at work during the day and __33__ to receive registered mail in person. There are limits, however. Items that are too large, too fragile, or too valuable __34__ be placed in a locker. Customers should also collect their parcels quickly; if a package stays in the locker for more than two days, it __35__ to a nearby post office for collection.

第 35 格：
questions.explain: 主詞 it 指 a package，與 move 為被動關係（包裹被移走），且條件句 if...stays 為現在式，主要子句表未來，故用 will be moved。will move、moves 為主動，語意變成包裹自己移動；has moved 時態與條件句不符。

questions.point: 克漏字二：條件連接詞 as long as
questions.stem:
【克漏字（二）】請依下文回答第 36～40 題。

Filing a claim for a lost parcel is not as complicated as it sounds, __36__ you keep the right documents. The first thing you need is the receipt issued at the counter, __37__ carries the tracking number of your item. Without it, the post office has no way of confirming that the parcel was ever mailed. Second, note the deadline. In most countries a claim must be submitted within a fixed period, and a request made after that period __38__ be accepted. Third, be specific about the contents. A general description such as "some gifts" makes it difficult for staff __39__ the value of what was lost. Finally, keep a copy of everything you submit. __40__ the process usually ends within a few weeks, disputes over valuable items can take much longer.

第 36 格：
questions.explain: 語意為「只要你保留正確文件」，表條件，故用 as long as。as far as 表範圍或距離（as far as I know），as soon as 表時間先後，as well as 表附加，均不表條件。

questions.point: 克漏字二：非限定關係子句 which
questions.stem:

A general description such as "some gifts" makes it difficult for staff __39__ the value of what was lost. 第 37 格：
questions.explain: 空格前有逗號，為非限定用法，只能用 which，不能用 that——這是 that 與 which 最實用的分辨點。it 為代名詞，會造成兩個子句缺連接詞；and 之後須有主詞，但 carries 前無主詞。

questions.point: 克漏字二：否定情態之語序

questions.point: 克漏字二：讓步連接詞 Although
questions.stem:
【克漏字（二）】請依下文回答第 36～40 題。

questions.stem:
【閱讀測驗（一）】請依下文回答第 41～45 題。

Before 1840, the cost of sending a letter in Britain was paid by the person who received it, and the price depended on how far the letter had travelled. The system caused endless trouble. Poor families often refused letters they could not afford, and clever senders learned to write messages on the outside of the envelope so that the receiver could read them, refuse the letter, and pay nothing at all.

A schoolteacher named Rowland Hill proposed a simple change: let the sender pay in advance, charge the same low price for any distance, and prove that the fee had been paid by sticking a small printed label on the envelope. The label became the world's first postage stamp, the Penny Black.

The results surprised even Hill's supporters. In the first year, the number of letters posted in Britain more than doubled. Because the price no longer depended on distance, keeping in touch with relatives far away became affordable for ordinary people for the first time. Within twenty years, most countries in Europe had copied the idea.

Hill's reform is often described as a triumph of technology, but the printed label was the least original part of it. What changed the postal world was the decision to charge everyone the same, regardless of distance — an idea that sounded reckless to the officials of his time and obvious to everyone after him.

第 41 題：What is the main idea of the passage?
options: A reform in how postage was charged, not the stamp itself, transformed the postal system
Postal services in Europe developed independently of one another
British families in the 1830s were too poor to send letters
The Penny Black was the most advanced printing technology of its time
questions.explain: 全文主線為「收件人付費、按距離計價」之弊病 → Hill 提出預付、統一費率 → 結果與影響，末段更明言印製標籤是其中最不具原創性的部分，真正改變郵政世界的是統一費率的決定。D 與末段主張相反，C 僅為背景細節，B 與第三段末「多數歐洲國家仿效」矛盾。

第 43 題：Which of the following was NOT part of Rowland Hill's proposal?
options: Charging a higher fee for letters sent to distant places
Having the sender pay before the letter was delivered
Using a printed label to show that the fee had been paid
Charging the same low price regardless of distance

第 45 題：In the last paragraph, the word "reckless" is closest in meaning to:

questions.stem:
【閱讀測驗（二）】請依下文回答第 46～50 題。

For villages separated from the nearest town by mountains or water, delivering mail has always been slow and expensive. In recent years several postal services have begun testing drones on these routes. A flight that takes twenty minutes can replace a road journey of two hours, and the cost per delivery falls sharply once the route is used regularly.

The early trials, however, revealed problems that had little to do with the aircraft. Weather was the most obvious one: strong winds ground the fleet for days at a time, and a service that works only in fair weather cannot replace a postman. Regulations were another. In most countries, drones may not be flown beyond the operator's line of sight without special permission, which limits routes to a few kilometres unless the rules are relaxed.

Public reaction has been mixed. Residents welcomed faster delivery of medicine and documents, but some complained about noise, and others worried that a drone landing in an open field was easier to steal from than a locked postal van. In one trial, the postal service responded by delivering only to fixed landing stations near village centres rather than to individual homes.

Most operators now describe drones as a supplement rather than a replacement. On the routes where they work, they work very well; the difficulty is that such routes are fewer than the early enthusiasm suggested.

第 46 題：Which of the following is the best title for the passage?
options: New Rules for Flying Drones in Cities
The Rising Cost of Delivering Mail to Villages
How Drones Have Replaced Rural Postmen
Drones in Postal Delivery: Promise and Limits
questions.explain: 全文結構為：優點（快速、成本下降）→ 問題（天候、法規、民眾反應）→ 結論（補充而非取代），標題須同時涵蓋潛力與限制。C 與末段明白矛盾，B 只觸及第一段一句，A 之城市法規非本文範圍（文中討論的是偏遠路線）。
